'''Vundar''', along with [[Grugosh]], guarded a secret entrance at the back of [[The Maze]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. The entrance led to a secret [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] base. Vundar and Grugosh were responsible for both guarding the entrance, and making sure Alliance contacts and recruits could access the base.<ref name="NRRG" />
